skill_concept: Read vulnerable framework or application source code, apply a minimal targeted patch that eliminates the vulnerability class at the framework level, and rebuild the project so the fix takes effect at runtime.
verdict_reason: Both tasks follow the same procedure: locate vulnerable source in a vendored/local framework, apply a minimal targeted patch (escaping untrusted input as plain text for SSTI; stripping path components for directory traversal), and rebuild the project so the fix takes effect at runtime. The tools overlap (source editing, build systems) and the failure modes are analogous.
weakest_link_reason: Flink requires a full Maven multi-module rebuild after patching Java source, adding significant build complexity and environment dependency compared to the Python in-place file edit needed for Flask.
